name: PWRWELL
recent: Powerwell 于2026年9月25日召开股东特别大会，通过每5股现有普通股送1份凭单的凭单派发计划，涉及116,110,400份凭单，并已获Bursa Securities批准。同期公司与Socomec达成战略合作，进军马来西亚数据中心与超大规模市场。最新季度（2026年6月30日止）营收环比增长113.0%，同比增长145.6%。
notable: 股东特别大会通过每5股送1份凭单的凭单派发计划，涉及116,110,400份凭单。
Bursa Securities 批准116,110,400份凭单上市及行使后最多116,110,400股新股上市。
公司与Socomec达成战略合作，拓展数据中心电力系统业务。
risks: 凭单行使后最多可发行116,110,400股新股，可能带来股权摊薄。

recent_en: Powerwell held an EGM on 25 September 2026 and passed the bonus issue of 116,110,400 warrants on the basis of 1 warrant for every 5 existing shares, which has been approved by Bursa Securities. The company also entered a strategic collaboration with Socomec to tap Malaysia's data centre and hyperscale market. For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue rose 113.0% QoQ and 145.6% YoY.
notable_en: EGM passed the bonus issue of 116,110,400 warrants on the basis of 1 warrant for every 5 existing shares.
Bursa Securities approved the listing of 116,110,400 warrants and up to 116,110,400 new shares upon exercise.
The company entered a strategic collaboration with Socomec to expand data centre power system capabilities.
risks_en: Exercise of the warrants may result in the issuance of up to 116,110,400 new shares, potentially diluting shareholding.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR88,287,000, up 113.0% QoQ and 145.6% YoY; net income was MYR9,014,000, up 17.5% QoQ and 114.6% YoY; net margin was 10.2%, down from 18.5% in the previous quarter.
